name: vet-resource-production
description: The command that runs the resource production loop end to end from a unit code and a college: the tas registry brief, the assessment pack, the learner guide and delivery deck, a clean-room AI verification against training.gov.au with a bounded rebuild loop, a staging package to Google Drive, and every row of the three compliance registers - assessment tool register, pre-use tool review record, industry consultation register - written as the build proceeds and as named people review, approve and publish. Never approves, never numbers a version 1.0, never uploads to eSkilled, never edits an approved document, never runs an unregistered AI use silently. Requires the vet-tas and vet-assessment plugins.

author.name: Meridian Vocational College / Adelaide Culinary Institute
